description_en: Queries the SSL client certificates that have been created
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnClientCerts接口查询已创建的SSL客户端证书
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-client-certs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-server-id vss-bp18q7hzj6largv4v0000 --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-bp1n8wcf134yl0osr0000 --name cert1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnClientCerts

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SSL client certificates that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的SSL客户端证书所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL server
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_server_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值：10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL client certificate belongs.

The SSL client certificate belongs to the same resource group as its associated SSL server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794078.html operation to query the resource group ID of the SSL server
parameters.help_zh:
SSL客户端证书所属的资源组ID。

SSL客户端证书与其关联的SSL服务端的资源组相同。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794078.html接口查询SSL服务端所属的资源组ID
